sup:70620.text:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. We are delighted to assist Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH and remain eager to serve all your requirements from our extensive product range.

We are pleased to submit our offer at a price of €4.96 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, and a contract term of 12 months. This offer stays valid for 30 days.

To give you complete visibility into our underlying costs, please note that LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 10 % of our cost. Furthermore, PPI-C2815 rose 0.8 % in twelve months and is 65 % of our cost. 

As your trusted partner, we pride ourselves on exceptional distributor service and look forward to continuing our successful business relationship.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH

move.subject: Re: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement
move.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

thank you for your offer regarding renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement.
The recorded demand forecast for part:360020 changed by +4.2% (fc:360020@2026-09).
Your recorded on-time delivery rate is 85 % (sc:70620@2026Q3).
The referenced orders for part:360020 each record a price of EUR 4.39 per price unit (po:4500014467-10, po:4500014389-10, po:4500014329-10, po:4500014280-20, po:4500014280-10, po:4500014171-10, po:4500014120-10, po:4500013994-10).
We are happy to pay faster if that helps your cash flow, in exchange for a better price.
Each of the attached packages works for us; please choose the one that suits you best.
We commit to a binding volume of 20,000 pcs per year over 24 months.
Could you send us a cost breakdown for this part?
We value our cooperation.

Best regards
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH, Purchasing

Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the delivery record data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. We checked the price history data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. That does not change our position. 

We acknowledge your request for a cost breakdown, which our team will address separately. Material accounts for about 65 % of our cost; more detail we do not share. 

Our main Angebot is a price of €4.94 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 24 months. As an alternative, building on your proposal for 14-day payment terms and a 24-month contract, we can offer a revised price of EUR 4.87 per unit with a price of €4.87 per unit, Zahlungsziel 14 days net, a contract term of 24 months. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH

move.text:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your ongoing partnership. We acknowledge your revised offer, but we are unable to reduce our price further. We would love to keep supporting your production, but this is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide.

To confirm where we stand, our offer is a price of €4.94 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, and a contract term of 24 months. Please note that our offer stays valid for 7 days.

We reiterate our request for binding release schedules to substantiate your volume commitment. Which figures is that based on? Please send us the data so we can better understand your planning.

We appreciate our business relationship and look forward to receiving your decision.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH
